meaning: Bind independent Workflow verification to exact checked source, authored typed calls, selected recovery, descriptor metadata and the forward native dependency closure.
construction_slice: R08ac3 binding foundation only; public semantic registration, effect audit and complete bounded cases remain pending.
source_ownership: Existing Workflow occurrence, binding, recovery and generation contracts own product meaning. Require branded graph and plan with the same source certificate, exact graph-member Workflow, and byte-pinned verification definition. Rebuild checked calls and recovery from authored selection and independently bound Operations, never from the generated Workflow descriptor.
dependency_metadata: The selected Operation dependency planner may supply its aggregate plan hash only. Every dependency action, callable, path and descriptor must also agree with independent Operation binding. It must not supply expected Workflow outcomes, arguments, values, traces or recovery. No Workflow renderer or generated recovery template is an oracle.
descriptor: Reconstruct the closed Workflow descriptor from checked source identities, profile-selected role, independently bound forward Operations and exact material/provider artifact hashes. Compare native descriptors against this independently constructed value; hash equality alone is not behavioral conformance.
closure: Bind all declared forward and compensation Operations for source checking, but admit only wrapper, provider, material module and forward Operation import closures for runtime observation. Repeated occurrences share imports, not occurrence identity. A compensation-only Operation must never enter the forward closure.
standard_library: Only the Workflow provider may import the named createHash binding from node:crypto for metadata hashing. This binding declaration is not an effect-audit exemption; source/native AST audit must separately restrict its use before public verification is enabled. Existing exact Enum support rules remain Operation-owned.
tests: Exact compiled native descriptor agrees with independent source-derived descriptor
Forged graph, plan, node and changed definition fail closed
Forward imports exclude compensation-only Operations and preserve all occurrence bindings
Selected typed closure and recovery identities remain source-bound
Compiling descriptor and import mutations disagree with the independent binding
compatibility: Add private binding and tests without changing predecessor product semantics, defaults, capsule or public Workflow not_evaluable posture.
claim_ceiling: Finite local candidate binding evidence only, not full Workflow verification, provider durability, admission, publication, release or CLI completion.
